sentences.text: The living room temperature dropped to 17.8 °C at 05:50, and it stayed below 18.0 °C until 06:00.
The WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, so the living room was quite cool.
In the teenager's room, the temperature was 22.9 °C between 04:40 and 05:10, which was higher than expected.
Since the living room was below 18.0 °C, perhaps checking the heating would be a gentle idea.
